# Foundation: Galactic Frontier — Complete Encyclopedia & Reference Guide
> Canonical Source: https://fgfwiki.com | Maintained by HawkTuah #1061 & FGF Community

---

## 1. Game Overview
- **Title**: Foundation: Galactic Frontier (FGF)
- **Publisher**: FunPlus
- **Genre**: Sci-Fi 4X Strategy MMO / RPG Combat
- **Platforms**: iOS, Android, PC (via Official Emulator / Web Client)
- **Core Mechanics**: Base building, Nexus research, fleet composition, flagship modification, champion ground squad battles, alliance warfare (SvS, GvG, Dominion Warzone), and space anomaly events.

---

## 2. Damage Types & Combat Synergy Matrix
FGF operates on a strategic triangular damage and resistance model:

1. **Kinetic (Ballistic / Physical)**:
   - *Strengths*: High burst hull damage against heavily armored flagships and capital structures.
   - *Advantage*: Overcomes Beam-centric builds through superior hull armor penetration.
   - *Key Heroes*: Doug Rockwell, Klara, Lucius Pullo.

2. **Beam (Laser / Energy)**:
   - *Strengths*: Continuous sustained energy damage, highly effective at melting shield barriers and light escort hulls.
   - *Advantage*: Counters Ion-heavy compositions by overloading shield regeneration capacitors.
   - *Key Heroes*: Jodie Beart, Evan Rogers, Eva von Trier.

3. **Ion (Electromagnetic / Disruption)**:
   - *Strengths*: Shield disruption, subsystem disabling, crowd control, and energy draining.
   - *Advantage*: Disables Kinetic targeting systems and defensive thrusters.
   - *Key Heroes*: Kama Moai, Killer Bee, Lani Verita.

**Fleet Power Optimization Principle**:
- Fleet Rating (March 1) depends heavily on flagship core synchronization, component mod tiers, and synergistic hero pairings.
- Stacking 3+ heroes of the matching energy type activates the +15% faction resonance buff.

---

## 3. Hero Tier List (Meta Rankings — 2026)

### S+ Tier (Supreme Meta Dominance)
- **Doug Rockwell** | Role: Vanguard (Tank) | Energy: Kinetic
  - *Specialty*: Massive personal damage mitigation, taunt aura, and reactive hull repair. Essential frontline for any Kinetic armada.
- **Kama Moai** | Role: Control / DPS | Energy: Ion
  - *Specialty*: AoE electromagnetic storm that stuns enemy flagships and disables weapon batteries for 4 seconds.
- **Jodie Beart** | Role: Support / Healer | Energy: Beam
  - *Specialty*: Continuous shield replenishment, energy recharge acceleration, and status cleanse.
- **Klara** | Role: Primary DPS | Energy: Kinetic
  - *Specialty*: Armor-piercing kinetic barrages with escalating critical strike rate against high-HP flagships.
- **Evan Rogers** | Role: Sniper DPS | Energy: Beam
  - *Specialty*: Focused long-range lance that ignores 30% of target shields and deals bonus damage to weakened enemies.

### S Tier (Top-Tier Competitive)
- **Lucius Pullo** | Role: Secondary Tank / Bruiser | Energy: Kinetic
  - *Specialty*: Intercepts enemy projectiles and grants armor buffs to adjacent escort ships.
- **Ajita** | Role: Tactician / Buffer | Energy: Ion
  - *Specialty*: Buffs fleet attack speed and increases Ion disruption duration by 25%.
- **Eva von Trier** | Role: Burst DPS | Energy: Beam
  - *Specialty*: Rapid-fire prismatic lasers causing stacking melting debuffs on enemy hulls.
- **Killer Bee** | Role: Flanker / Assassin | Energy: Ion
  - *Specialty*: High evasion, backline flagship harasser, and energy cell sabotage.
- **Lani Verita** | Role: Control / Disruptor | Energy: Ion
  - *Specialty*: EMP pulse slowing enemy fleet march speed and targeting recovery.
- **Lily** | Role: Support / Shield Battery | Energy: Beam
  - *Specialty*: Overcharges companion shields and converts excess energy into offensive beam boosts.
- **Aliya** | Role: Support / Tactical Officer | Energy: Kinetic
  - *Specialty*: Fleet march speed boost and kinetic ammo replenishment rate amplification.

---

## 4. Flagship Archetypes & Meta Decks

### Kinetic Heavy Artillery Deck
- **Flagship**: Ironclad Dreadnought
- **Primary Hero**: Doug Rockwell (Lead) + Klara (DPS) + Lucius Pullo (Defense)
- **Core Components**: Reinforced Composite Armor, Heavy Railgun Battery, Kinetic Overdrive Core.
- **Tactical Strategy**: Withstand initial energy salvos using high hull HP, then obliterate opposing flagships with massive kinetic volleys.

### Beam Sustained Meltdown Deck
- **Flagship**: Solaris Battlecruiser
- **Primary Hero**: Jodie Beart (Lead) + Evan Rogers (DPS) + Eva von Trier (DPS)
- **Core Components**: Prismatic Focus Array, Shield Harmonizer, Continuous Beam Projector.
- **Tactical Strategy**: Maintain unbroken shield uptime while melting enemy escorts with stacking beam damage.

### Ion Disruption & Control Deck
- **Flagship**: Tempest Carrier
- **Primary Hero**: Kama Moai (Lead) + Killer Bee (Flank) + Ajita (Buff)
- **Core Components**: EMP Resonance Generator, Ion Pulse Launcher, Electronic Warfare Subsystem.
- **Tactical Strategy**: Lock down enemy weapon systems and disrupt flagship commands, leaving targets helpless against strike craft.

---

## 5. Optimal Ground Team Compositions

### Early Game Progression Team
- Frontline: Doug Rockwell (Tank) + Lucius Pullo (Bruiser)
- Midline: Starter DPS + Klara
- Backline: Jodie Beart (Healer)

### Mid Game Competitive Team
- Frontline: Doug Rockwell (Tank)
- Midline: Klara (Kinetic DPS) + Eva von Trier (Beam DPS)
- Backline: Kama Moai (Ion CC) + Jodie Beart (Healer)

### Late Game High-End PvP Arena Team
- Frontline: Doug Rockwell (Kinetic Vanguard)
- Midline: Klara (Kinetic DPS) + Evan Rogers (Beam Sniper)
- Backline: Kama Moai (Ion CC) + Jodie Beart (Beam Support/Cleanse)

---

## 6. Major Events & Walkthrough Strategies

### Operation Blackout
- *Objective*: Cooperative alliance wave defense against corrupted alien swarms.
- *Strategy*: Position Ion control fleets near choke points to stall boss waves; deploy Beam fleets behind to melt swarm clusters. Coordinate active time slots via Guild Timezone tools.

### Kaboom Event
- *Objective*: High-yield asteroid mining and explosive demolition for rare ores.
- *Strategy*: Save speedup tokens for mining efficiency stages. Target gold-tier asteroid clusters during 2x multiplier windows.

### Arms Race (Stages A & B)
- *Objective*: Daily recurring milestones for building, researching, training, and hero upgrading.
- *Strategy*: Sync building completion and Nexus research timers with matching Arms Race stages to double-dip event rewards and tournament rankings.

### Guild vs Guild (GvG) & State vs State (SvS)
- *Structure*: Days 1-5 preparation (resource gathering, tech upgrade, troop training), Day 6 cross-state PvP war.
- *Strategy*: Rally leaders must utilize full S+ Kinetic or Ion decks. Establish 24/7 watch shifts for night defense to prevent rally sniping.

### Stella Anomaly (ARG & In-Game Mystery)
- *Objective*: Interactive puzzle deciphering codes across galactic anomalies.
- *Phases*: 4 progressive security decrypt phases requiring lore knowledge, Morse decoding, and binary terminal input.

---

## 7. Interactive Calculators & Math Formulas

### 1. Build Time Speedup Formula
```
Effective Time = Base Build Time / (1 + (Total Construction Speed% / 100))
Speedup Required = Effective Time - Current Elapsed Time
```

### 2. Champion Upgrade Requirements
- Leveling progression requires Champion EXP chips and Tactical Manuals.
- Major tier milestones occur at Levels 10, 20, 40, 60, 80, 100.
- Skill upgrades require Skill Books corresponding to the champion's energy type (Kinetic, Beam, Ion).

### 3. Nexus Research Scaling
- Research speed increases with Nexus Laboratory level and Alliance Tech tree investments.
- High-tier military tech (T5/T6 fleets) requires prior completion of all prerequisite economic nodes.

## 8. Active Redeemable Gift Codes
*(Verified and regularly updated on FGF Wiki)*

- **FLEET777**: 500x Diamonds, 5x Advanced Recruitment Tickets, 10x 1-Hour Speedups.
- **FOUNDATION**: 300x Diamonds, 100,000x Titanium, 100,000x Energy Crystals.
- **HERO777**: 3x Legendary Hero Shards, 20x Level-2 Tactical Manuals.
- **NEWFRONTIER**: 1,000x Diamonds, 10x Fleet Speedups.
- **GALAXYWITHYOU**: 250x Diamonds, 50,000x Alloy, 50,000x Fuel.

*How to Redeem*:
1. Open *Foundation: Galactic Frontier*.
2. Tap your **Avatar** (top left).
3. Navigate to **Settings** > **Redeem Code** (or **Gift Code**).
4. Enter code and confirm; rewards arrive instantly in the in-game mailbox.

## 9. FGF Guild Management Tool (ERP)
- **Official URL**: https://guildmanagement.vercel.app/
- **Key Features**:
  - **16 AI Vision OCR Scanners**: Automated extraction of Roster stats, SvS/GvG leaderboards, Shadowfront attendance, and Glory tallies from screenshots in 3 seconds.
  - **7D Military Matrix**: Visualizes power across Fleet, Tech, Flagship, Champions, Crew, Glory, and Total Power.
  - **24/7 Timezone Coverage**: Heatmaps displaying hourly active fleet power to eliminate night vulnerability.
  - **Automated Shadowfront Squads**: Algorithmic selection of 20 Starters / 10 Reserves based on real attendance.
  - **Player Portal**: Dedicated self-service portal for member growth tracking and 1-click absence reporting.
  - **Discord Webhooks**: Automatic lineup and battle report dispatch.
